results.reader_title: EU budget impasse threatens planned chip and AI initiatives
results.reader_what: A Politico Europe report says unresolved EU budget questions have slowed talks on strategic policy initiatives, including AI and chips.
results.reader_why: Unsettled funding expectations may impede agreement on new technology, research and industrial measures.
results.reader_more: The report describes legislative work and policy coordination slowed by uncertainty around forthcoming EU budget arrangements. EU chip and AI initiatives are among the areas reportedly affected. As this is a news account reproduced outside its original publisher, the evidence supports a review-grade account of a negotiating obstacle, not a formal policy freeze.

metadata_correction.reason: The OECD original catalogue lists 1 September 2025 publication (rather than the provisional July date); authors are Donoso Salas, Białogłowska and Flood.

results.reader_title: OECD eastern-border development report is not an R&I study
results.reader_what: The OECD report examines living conditions and economic attractiveness in EU eastern border regions.
results.reader_more: The OECD report compares the socio-economic attractiveness of European eastern border territories, including public services, mobility and investment. Although innovation is relevant to regional growth, the report’s primary object is broad territorial development. It is not an evidence-led study of Europe’s R&I system as required for A.
